title: Review: Final Fantasy Resonance (PS5) - Square's Series Returns to Its Roots to Fantastic Effect
summary:
Crystal clear.

For well over a decade now, some Final Fantasy fans have been demanding a return to a more traditional gameplay structure. And while Final Fantasy Resonance is a far cry from being a mainline AAA Final Fantasy game, it provides a glimpse of what a modern instalment could look like, if it adhered to old-school sensibilities.

Resonance is built on the foundations laid by Final Fantasy Brave Exvius — the now defunct mobile game. But this isn't just some weird console port; it's a full-on rework that strips Exvius of its free-to-play systems and reimagines it as a classic turn-based adventure.
